title: My friend group trying to build one IKEA wardrobe
idea: Friends try to, episode 1: the spell builds it upside down, the flip knocks a door off, Reaper fixes it with one turn of the Allen key, then Viking leans on it and it folds flat (the back panel was never used)

hook.what: the loose panels slap down, the instructions are upside down

do.reason: the flat-pack top panel slaps flat on the floor
the panels fly up into the spell
the upside-down wardrobe lands on its top
the Allen key's quarter turn: the bolt clicks tight
both doors swing shut with a soft clack
the wardrobe creaks as it racks under his elbow
the series sting on the tiny undo (the same in every episode)
the wardrobe folds flat on the floor: whump

visible.why: P1: the loose panels, the upside-down instructions, the phone, Reaper waiting
P2: the wardrobe built upside down in the spell
P3: Viking flips it, the door swings off into the Wizard's hat
P4: the blame, the tutorial pushed away by both
P5: the key in the bolt, the quarter turn (the insert)
P5: the wardrobe squares up, the doors swing shut
P5: Reaper turns back to us, deadpan
WE DID IT: all four cheering at the result
THE GLARE: three annoyed faces turned to Viking, his sheepish grin
P8: the unused back panel still leans on the wall

allowClip.reason: Reaper sits on the cardboard box and gets up from it
the loose door swings into the Wizard's hat brim (the bonk)
Viking's palms on its side for the heave
Viking's elbow and palm on the wardrobe's side as he leans on it
Reaper's key in the bolt on the wardrobe's side, his mitten against it
Viking holds the side panel up by its edge
